messages:
vivian: Quick heads-up  Sable Finance signed a 24-month Dedicated renewal and we pushed their Red Hat Marketplace listing live this morning: https://marketplace.redhat.com/en-us/partners/sable-redwood. They used a Red Hat Private Offer and migrated their production inference pipelines to Dedicated OCP clusters. Big strategic win for regulated fintech. :tada:

omar: Amazing! Renewal summary: 16 reserved GPU slots, 30% committed discount, enterprise SLA + SOC2 addendum. They also secured co-marketing funds for a joint webinar.

redhat-marketplace-bot: Red Hat Marketplace listing published (Offer Slug: sable-redwood-2026). Private Offer available  PO ID: RH-PO-334455.

neha: Legal confirmed PO language and signed the case study release. Sable approved the public quote and the architecture diagram. We cleared cross-border data-flow text for APAC and EMEA.

tiago: Performance note from Sable ENG: 3.8x throughput uplift and ~45% reduction in cost per inference after switching to Redwood Dedicated + prefix caching. They also reported more consistent P99 latency during peak trading windows.

eng-runtime: Onboarding items: Sable requested HSM/KMS rotation guidance, per-tenant KV-cache presets, and a recommended quantization profile (q4_1) for their medium-sized transformer models. We'll publish a short tuning runbook and schedule a 1:1 session.

legal: Final approved quote for press: "Redwood gave us predictable inference at trading scale while substantially lowering unit costs." Sable signed off.

growth: Marketing - can you queue the co-branded blog + webinar? Proposed timeline: blog Mon, webinar Thu (invite + registration page), console banner Fri. Also request a short joint press snippet for PR.

omar: I've uploaded assets: https://drive.redwood.internal/partners/sable-finance (case-study.pdf, topology.svg, 40s demo). Growth/marketing, please confirm social copy.

redhat-marketplace-bot: Day 1 metrics: 23 listing views, 5 private-offer inquiries, 2 trial activations. Will post a 72h digest in #partnerships.

neha: Please add a 3-bullet how-to in docs for Red Hat Marketplace Private Offer + Dedicated: accept offer, link RH account, follow Dedicated onboarding checklist. Eng-docs, can you draft that by EOD?

eng-runtime: Noted  we'll include KV-cache warmup steps, recommended batch sizes, and a sample monitor dashboard. ETA: Wednesday.

vivian: Thanks team  big milestone for our Red Hat/regulated customers motion. If anyone needs to tweak the quote or assets DM me. We'll coordinate final go-live time with Sable and PR. :rocket:
